@@ -109,9 +109,21 @@
-    def _build_vocab(self):
-        # vocab is simply and deterministically derived from merges
-        vocab = BYTE_VOCAB.copy()
-        for (p0, p1), idx in self.merges.items():
-            vocab[idx] = vocab[p0] + vocab[p1]
-        for special, idx in self.special_tokens.items():
-            vocab[idx] = special.encode("utf-8")
-        return vocab
-
+    def _build_vocab(self):
+        # vocab is simply and deterministically derived from merges
+        merges = self.merges
+        special_tokens = self.special_tokens
+        cache_key = None
+        if len(merges) >= 512:
+            cache_key = (tuple(merges.items()), tuple(special_tokens.items()))
+            cached = _VOCAB_CACHE.get(cache_key)
+            if cached is not None:
+                return cached.copy()
+        vocab = BYTE_VOCAB.copy()
+        for (p0, p1), idx in merges.items():
+            vocab[idx] = vocab[p0] + vocab[p1]
+        for special, idx in special_tokens.items():
+            vocab[idx] = special.encode("utf-8")
+        if cache_key is not None:
+            if len(_VOCAB_CACHE) >= _VOCAB_CACHE_MAX:
+                _VOCAB_CACHE.clear()
+            _VOCAB_CACHE[cache_key] = vocab.copy()
+        return vocab
+

+                s = rendered_vocab[idx]
